scope: Canonical spam disposition distinguishes allow, definitive filter and pending relationship readiness. In nonfriends mode a suspicious message with an unloaded, failed, foreign-account or stale-auth-generation friend snapshot stays pending. A complete READY empty snapshot confirms a nonfriend. Existing all/off/self/restored behavior remains immediate without a relationship read.

Pending message bodies, group children, actions and previews are suppressed without creating a spam inbox record. UI labels pending as a check rather than claiming spam, with explicit retry after failure. Classification remains the existing deterministic client-side rule classifier; decrypted content is not sent to the server.

One shared per-account/auth-generation friend-list read is bounded to fifteen seconds. Concurrent message decisions join it; failures do not create automatic fetch loops. Explicit retry or canonical readiness changes allow reevaluation. Source, account, mode and revision checks are repeated after asynchronous work.

Incoming channel and DM notifications wait for the bounded relationship decision. Confirmed friends retain normal content cues; unresolved failure keeps a generic nonbody arrival and unread indication without TTS, full preview or automatic selected-conversation read. Existing muting rules remain.

FriendsView shows loading/error/retry honestly, retains only matching-account rows on failed refresh, hides foreign rows, and shows an empty-friends result only for a complete READY snapshot. Retry clicks are deduplicated.

Canonical shouldSuppressMessagePreview returns true for both filter and pending. P11 overlay preview/reply callers are integrated by the separate P11 owner and are not included in this staging path list.
